arcane-signet.opening: Arcane Signet was first printed in the Throne of Eldraine Brawl decks, released on 4 October 2019. Compare later artwork, borderless versions and foil finishes separately from that original printing.

previous.opening: Deflecting Swat debuted in Commander 2020 in 2020. C20 #50 is a rare illustrated by Izzy and is nonfoil only. It was included in the Arcane Maelstrom deck associated with Kalamax, the Stormsire.

deflecting-swat.opening: Deflecting Swat changes targets; it does not counter spells or abilities. It cannot redirect an untargeted board wipe. Its first printing is Commander 2020 (C20) #50, a nonfoil-only rare illustrated by Izzy, included in the Arcane Maelstrom deck associated with Kalamax, the Stormsire. The targeted-versus-untargeted distinction is explained below.
